title: Claudio TDCG config
description: An object with test_command and test_files: how this project runs its tests and which files are tests.

$schema.description: Text: where editors find this schema, e.g. "./config.schema.json".

test_command.description: Text: the command that runs the tests, e.g. "./gradlew test". Not empty or only spaces.

test_files.description: A list of at least one file pattern that says which files are tests.

claude_free_writing_files.description: Optional. A list of file patterns Claude may change in any phase, tests included. .tdcg/ stays locked.

file_pattern.description: A file pattern, e.g. "docs/**". Paths start from the project folder. Not empty.
